source.locator: View, Text, Image versus DOM elements
source.paraphrase: React Native renders native views, not DOM nodes. A lowercase DOM tag in a render path has no native counterpart.

invariants.why: A div or button compiles but renders nothing on device, and the failure is silent until manual QA on a phone.
invariants.fixHint: Render View, Text, Image, TextInput, or Pressable instead of the DOM tag with the same name.
invariants.avoid: Wrapping the DOM tag around a native child does not make it native. The outer tag still renders nothing.

source.paraphrase: A FlatList needs a keyExtractor function so rows keep stable keys across inserts, deletes, and reorders.

invariants.why: Without stable keys a list reuses the wrong row state after an insert, showing one order's data in another order's row.
invariants.fixHint: Pass keyExtractor={(item) => item.id} with a stable id from the data.
invariants.avoid: A keyExtractor string names no function and leaves rows keyed by index. A key on an inner View is not the list key.

source.paraphrase: The app never terminates its own process. Exiting is the OS job; screens go back through navigation instead.

invariants.why: Killing the process looks like a crash to the OS and the user, breaks state restoration, and reads as a guideline violation on review.
invariants.fixHint: Navigate back to the previous screen and unsubscribe the hardware-back listener instead of exiting.
invariants.avoid: Calling exitApp through an imported helper or inside a back-press handler is the same kill with one hop in between.

source.work: React Native AsyncStorage docs, security guidance
source.paraphrase: AsyncStorage is unencrypted on-device storage. Tokens, passwords, and keys never go through its write calls.

invariants.why: Anything in AsyncStorage is readable on a rooted device or a backup, so a stored refresh token is a stored credential.
invariants.fixHint: Keep tokens in the keychain or secure store, and keep only preferences and public state in AsyncStorage.
invariants.avoid: Batching the secret inside multiSet, or encrypting it with a key that sits next to it in the same store.

source.paraphrase: All text nodes must be wrapped inside a <Text> component. A text node cannot sit directly under a <View>.

invariants.why: React Native has no implicit text node: a bare string under View throws 'Text strings must be rendered within a <Text> component' and the screen crashes.
invariants.fixHint: Wrap the string in <Text>. For a pressable label, put <Text> inside the Pressable or TouchableOpacity.
invariants.avoid: Only literal JSX text, quoted strings and templates with text placed directly inside View, ScrollView, SafeAreaView, KeyboardAvoidingView, Pressable, TouchableOpacity, TouchableHighlight or ImageBackground imported from react-native (renames included) are flagged. Whitespace, comments, variables, numbers and conditional expressions are not checked. Same-named components from other modules, such as themed wrappers that render their own Text, pass.

source.work: React Native documentation, Optimizing FlatList Configuration (https://reactnative.dev/docs/optimizing-flatlist-configuration)
source.paraphrase: Move the renderItem function outside of the render function or wrap it in useCallback so it does not recreate itself each time the component renders.

invariants.why: An inline arrow or function expression creates a new function reference on every render, forcing FlatList, SectionList, and VirtualizedList cells to re-render during scroll.
invariants.fixHint: Hoist the renderItem function to module scope or wrap it in useCallback, and pass the stable reference to renderItem.
invariants.avoid: Both arrow functions and function expressions passed directly in renderItem={...} on FlatList, SectionList, or VirtualizedList are matched. Non-list custom components are ignored.
